items.text: Launching a different Ghoztty build on Linux asks Switch / Open Window / Cancel, as on Windows.
The Linux launch's build identity read is registered with the self-spawn audit.
Linux refreshes an older background agent when nothing is running in it, and asks before restarting one it cannot talk to.
A small Ghoztty-Setup.exe now runs the installer and says in Ghoztty's own dialog when another installation is in the way.
The Linux pane sidebar shows stash, restore, close and + buttons on the row under the pointer.
The Linux pane sidebar's rows drag up and down to reorder their window's list.
The Linux pane sidebar edits groups: a window row menu and the Ungrouped header pencil.
The update-applier test harnesses no longer leave the dev ghoztty-debug:// link handler pointing at a deleted temp folder.
Linux image panes copy a phone photo upright, and show an oriented TIFF upright.
A sized popup on Linux now gives its page the size the page asked for.
